name: La Bresse
description: La Bresse Hohneck is the largest ski resort in the Vosges, on the slopes of the Hohneck summit (1,363m). 30 runs (4 green, 8 blue, 12 red, 6 black), 15 lifts, 70% snowmaking. 3 sectors: Le Hohneck (panoramic reds, guided off-piste), La Vologne (family heart, snowpark, beginner zone), and a small linked domain. Night skiing Tuesday and Friday evenings (5-9pm, €15). Bike park with 7 downhill runs in summer. Lac des Corbeaux glacial lake loop walk. Blueberry picking on high meadows. Craft beer bar 'La Corne du Diable'. Nordic spa at Bains de Bien-Être. Day pass ~€42 adult.

overview.atmosphere: Largest ski resort in the Vosges massif. 30 runs, 21km, 15 lifts. Hohneck summit (1,363m). Night skiing (Tue/Fri 5-9pm, €15). Snowpark, 70% snowmaking. Blueberry picking in summer. Bike park. Lac des Corbeaux glacial lake.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Snowpark (La Vologne), cross-country skiing (Marcairie plateau), dog sledding, tree climbing park (age 3+), craft beer bar 'La Corne du Diable', Thursday producer market.
